name: dora-assessment
description: Assess DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act) compliance evidence across all five pillars — ICT risk management, incident reporting, resilience testing and TLPT, the Register of Information and ICT third-party risk, and information sharing — by cross-checking the E&P Knowledge Base against your own ServiceNow data — a connected ServiceNow MCP, a CMDB export, or a described environment.
